fato_historico: 1776: The Continental Congress officially names its union of states the United States.
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a monumental shift for you, Leo. Much like the birth of a grand new union, consider how you might unify your boldest dreams into a singular purpose. It is a good time to lead with kindness, as your radiant presence naturally draws people together in a collaborative, golden alignment of shared ambitions and heart-centered goals.
frase_do_dia: Great things are accomplished when we unite our hearts with a common purpose.
significado_numero: Represents the transformative power of new beginnings and building a strong foundation.
conselho: Stand tall in your authority and welcome collaboration with an open, warm heart.
